# assistant-text

## Type Aliases

### AssistantPart

```ts
type AssistantPart = Readonly<{
  type: string;
  text?: string;
  textSignature?: string;
}>;
```

One assistant content block; only text blocks carry reader-visible text.

## Functions

### assistantTextBlocks()

```ts
function assistantTextBlocks(content): readonly string[];
```

The reply a reader sees: every text block, except that an OpenAI `commentary`
block is a draft of the turn and yields to a `final_answer` block in the same
message. A commentary preamble that differs from the final answer is hidden here
too: it stays in storage and in provider replay, and is only left out of what a
person reads. Commentary stays visible when no final answer exists, such as
progress text ahead of a tool call.
